blocks.raw: <ExamTip>The board foot formula catches many candidates off guard because the inputs mix imperial units. Practice until the formula is automatic: BF = T(in) × W(in) × L(ft) ÷ 12. A 2×6 at 14 feet = 2 × 6 × 14 ÷ 12 = 14 board feet.</ExamTip>
